content_sections.text: The Government of Nagaland, Office of the Director General of Police, Kohima, has invited applications for Constable (GD) posts through a district-based recruitment process. The following table summarizes the eligibility, vacancies, salary, important dates, application fee, selection criteria, physical requirements and official contact details. Important: The recruitment is restricted to eligible Indigenous Inhabitant Tribes of Nagaland. Applicants must meet the tribe-wise and district-wise conditions in the notification. The 84 backlog vacancies have separate allocation requirements.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Online registration for Nagaland Police Constable GD Recruitment 2026 will begin on 31 October 2026. Candidates must complete the application and pay the examination fee by the closing date of 30 November 2026. Admit cards will be generated after successful completion of the online application and may be downloaded immediately thereafter. Written examination and interview schedules will be communicated through the official Nagaland Police website and local newspapers.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Nagaland Police has advertised 1,137 Constable GD vacancies. Of these, 1,053 vacancies are allocated through the current recruitment under the approved tribal ratio, while 84 are backlog vacancies from the previous recruitment. content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable District-wise Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The 1,053 regular recruitment vacancies are distributed among participating districts according to the approved tribal ratio based on the 2011 Census. The district allocation also includes separate male and female vacancies. The original notification provides detailed tribe-wise allocations within these districts in Annexure I. Applicants must check the specific tribe and district allocation before selecting their application district.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Backlog Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notification also provides 84 backlog Constable GD vacancies reserved for specific tribes and districts whose vacancies remained unfilled in the preceding recruitment. All 84 backlog vacancies are allocated to male candidates. Special Condition: The single Phom backlog vacancy under Mokokchung is restricted to eligible members of the Phom tribe belonging to Anaki (Old) and Anaki 'C' villages. Candidates applying for backlog posts must satisfy the exact district, residence and tribe conditions provided in Annexure III.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The educational qualification for Nagaland Police Constable GD Recruitment 2026 depends on the applicant's tribe classification. Candidates must also possess valid documents establishing their Indigenous Inhabitant and tribal eligibility. The educational qualification must be from a recognized board or educational authority. Where a pass certificate or provisional pass certificate has not been issued, the notification requires an appropriate certificate or letter from the concerned educational institution or authority. The recruitment is open to eligible male and female candidates from Indigenous Inhabitant Tribes of Nagaland who meet the prescribed age, education, district and physical fitness requirements. Applicants must possess an Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate and relevant tribal certificates issued by the competent authority. Eligible natives or residents of Dimapur, Chumoukedima and Niuland can apply under the combined allocation for these three districts, provided they possess the prescribed supporting certificates. The notification also provides specific arrangements for members of the Chang, Sumi and Phom tribes from identified villages in Mokokchung, Wokha and Shamator districts. Candidates affected by these provisions should refer to the detailed conditions in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Serving Government employees may receive upper-age relaxation equivalent to their qualifying service, subject to a maximum of five years and the applicable Government policy. The notification also provides age-relaxation conditions for certain incumbent Nagaland Police Constables and petitioners covered by the specified Gauhati High Court judgments and orders.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The advertised Constable GD posts carry Pay Level 3, with Grade Pay Rs. 1,800 under the specified pay-band structure of Rs. 5,200–20,200.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The examination fee for Nagaland Police Constable Recruitment 2026 is Rs. 300 . Applicants must pay the fee online as part of the application process.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for the Constable GD posts involves physical and medical screening, outdoor physical efficiency tests, an objective-type written examination, interview and NCC certification assessment. Candidates must qualify in the required physical and medical standards before participating in outdoor tests. Only candidates who qualify the PET will be called for the written examination.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Physical Standard Test 2026
content_sections.text: The notification prescribes different minimum height and chest measurements for male and female candidates. Candidates who do not meet the physical requirements may be disqualified during the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Physical Efficiency Test 2026
content_sections.text: The Physical Efficiency Test carries 45 marks and includes running, pull-ups, high jump and long jump. Male and female candidates have separate qualifying standards. Disqualification: Male candidates taking longer than 12 minutes 30 seconds and female candidates taking longer than 12 minutes will be disqualified. Nagaland Police Constable Syllabus 2026 Male candidates completing fewer than six pull-ups and female candidates completing fewer than three pull-ups will be disqualified. A maximum of three attempts is permitted. Candidates who fail to meet the required qualifying standard in any of the outdoor tests will not be permitted to continue in the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Written Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Nagaland Police Constable written examination will consist of 80 multiple-choice questions carrying 40 marks. Candidates will receive two hours to complete the question paper, which will be set in English.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Written Exam Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The written examination may cover the following subjects and knowledge areas specified in the official notification: General Awareness and General Knowledge General Science Indian History Indian Polity Social Sciences Elementary Mathematics Sports Naga Culture and Heritage Nagaland State and Naga Tribes General Mental Aptitude

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Interview and NCC Marks 2026
content_sections.text: After the PET and written examination, candidates will be shortlisted for interview based on the aggregate marks obtained in these two stages. The shortlisting ratio is three candidates for each available post. The interview carries 10 marks, and NCC certification may contribute up to 5 additional marks to the overall merit assessment.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Medical Fitness Requirements
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the medical fitness standards prescribed for police service. Medical examination includes assessment of height, weight, chest, vision, hearing and physical fitness. The notification identifies several disqualifying conditions, including: Eyesight below the prescribed standard. Colour blindness. Deafness or serious hearing impairment. Varicose veins. Squint eyes. Amputated limbs or physical extremities. Physical deformities, including flat feet and knocked knees. Adverse drug screening or alcohol abuse test findings. Candidates must also satisfy the medical and physical requirements during the recruitment process and subsequent training.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Nagaland Police Constable Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible applicants must submit their applications through the Nagaland Police Registration Portal between 31 October and 30 November 2026. Offline applications will not be accepted. Important: Applicants must submit only through the official online recruitment portal. Applications submitted to police offices or other establishments will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Documents Required 2026
content_sections.text: Original documents must be produced whenever required during the recruitment process. Applicants should ensure that the details submitted online match their supporting certificates.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Probation and Posting
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will undergo a probation period of two years. Service confirmation will depend on satisfactory completion of probation, medical clearance and verification of antecedents under the applicable rules. Fresh recruits will initially be deployed in India Reserve (IR) Battalions and may be required to serve within or outside Nagaland according to the instructions of the Nagaland Police Department.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Nagaland Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Nagaland Police has advertised 1,137 Constable GD vacancies, including 1,053 regular recruitment posts and 84 backlog posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Nagaland Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application submission is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When will Nagaland Police Constable online applications start?
faq.answer: Online applications will open on 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for Nagaland Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applicants belonging to the notified Backward Tribes must have passed Class 6, while candidates from other eligible Naga tribes must have passed Class 8 or possess a higher recognized qualification.

faq.question: Q5. Can Class 6 pass candidates apply for Nagaland Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. The notification permits Class 6 pass candidates belonging to the notified Backward Tribes of Nagaland to apply, subject to the remaining eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q6. Can Class 8 pass candidates apply for Nagaland Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Class 8 pass candidates belonging to eligible Naga tribes can apply if they meet the required age, district and physical standards.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for Nagaland Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 37 years old as on 14 October 2026, with relaxation for eligible serving Government employees and other specifically covered applicants.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Nagaland Police Constable GD posts?
faq.answer: The Constable GD post carries Pay Level 3 with Grade Pay Rs. 1,800 under the stated Pay Band of Rs. 5,200–20,200.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee for Nagaland Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The examination fee is Rs. 300 and must be paid online. It is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q10. What is the minimum height required for male candidates?
faq.answer: The minimum height for male candidates is 5 feet 3 inches.
